long_biography.plain_text:
Building across three commercial-shipping markets has defined Andreas Hadjiyiannis's career. He entered an industry in which his family already owned ships, then established Cyprus Sea Lines and Cyprus Maritime under his own leadership. The companies developed positions in dry-bulk and container transport, with Hadjiyiannis becoming known for acquiring established ships when market conditions created value.

Hellenic Tankers added crude-oil and petroleum-product transportation to the group. That step broadened the platform without abandoning its acquisition-led model, leaving the private companies able to move between different shipping cycles. Hadjiyiannis continues as chief executive of Cyprus Sea Lines and Hellenic Tankers. Beyond the companies, he spent nine consecutive years as president of the Cyprus Union of Shipowners before continuing in its leadership as vice president.
